text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
choice_data_list: Royce, do you think you can go?
Royce, do you think you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, I'm sorry.
I was just doing a bit of visualization training.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "We can't let our last defeat go to waste. We need to figure out our best race strategy based on why we lost."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, I'm sure I can cross the finish line in first.
And then I'll think to myself, "This victory was
by no means an easy one."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Having exhausted every ounce of my strength, I stumble after the finish line.
Worried voices involuntarily rise from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I will not fall. I'll stand on both feet
and wave with a smile. Thunderous applause will rain down on me
for overcoming both defeat and a battle to the death!”
choice_data_list: If you can visualize it that clearly, you'll be fine.
If you can visualize it that clearly, you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, exactly.
Now, let's go pay back what we owe them
with interest!
